description: 12 steps of a survival player at a chiseled bookshelf facing south with a comparator behind it: a book clicked into each sixth of the front (upper and lower row, from the left: slots 0 to 5, each book used up), a book on a full slot taking its book back, an empty hand taking two books, a stick on an empty slot doing nothing and on a full one taking its book into the inventory; the slots, the held stack, the inventory and the comparator's last slot touched; Circuit and both official servers give identical output
